_doc: Turbo gameplay tuning knobs for FC27.exe build 6AC07E31-2145C000 (turbogui/src/core/tuning.h). NOTHING HERE IS VERIFIED IN THE RUNNING GAME:
every knob and locator is 'verified': false, so Turbo shows 'not located on this build' and never writes it.
Source: turbo_output\TACTICS_MOD_CATALOGUE.txt (FC 27 type data). collection = the attribulator group, field = the reflected field
name, offset = its offset in the group's type, default = FC 27's own value (display / Reset only; the live value read first rules).
min / max are Turbo's safety range. No gameplay mod's values are in this file; Turbo's presets are relative changes.
Track T1 (the live locator) confirms each locator in the running game (type found by name with this signature / size / field count,
one instance per variant found by its Name, the field offsets equal) and each knob, fills the simulation variants' instance names,
and only then sets 'verified': true. A verified knob needs collection, field, locator, offset, min and max; a verified attrib locator
needs type, type_signature, type_size, type_fields and every variant's instance name, else the whole file is refused.
Locator kinds: 'attrib' (type + field names, variants = database copies written together), 'chain' (signature + pointer chain + header
checks), 'native' (code in src/win/tuning_win.cpp). A knob's 'below' lists knobs it must stay below (the line height bands).
note: catalogue entries (FC 27 type data), all unverified: waiting for the live locator (track T1)
